adapter.semantic_representation: knowledge-graph direct triples, endpoint-conditioned ordered two-hop paths, and relation-composition schemas

behavioral_estimand_metadata_if_present.artifact_status: aggregate metrics reported; no checkpoint, per-item predictions, or training logs

benchmark.name: Implementing Tensor Logic: Unifying Datalog and Neural Reasoning via Tensor Contraction
benchmark.scope: Experiment 3B compositional reasoning benchmark only; standard link prediction and unrelated genealogy/country experiments are outside the candidate audit.

allowed_wording: Direct-edge withholding succeeded for all 1,000 test paths.
Retained endpoint-conditioned two-hop witnesses establish a 484/1,000 semantic-overlap lower bound.
Relation-composition schemas were witnessed for 999/1,000 test paths.
forbidden_wording: Every test path remains executable after direct-edge removal.
No retained witness proves semantic novelty.
The public artifacts establish a behavioral effect.

observation_contract.admissible_inputs_and_contexts: Frozen FB15k-237 validation/test queries evaluated against the final scrubbed training graph.
observation_contract.nondeterminism: No runtime nondeterminism remains after the graph and query manifests are frozen.
observation_contract.observable_outputs: Direct-triple membership, retained endpoint-conditioned two-hop paths, and ordered relation-schema presence.
observation_contract.resource_observations: Runtime and memory are excluded from semantic identity.

semantic_unit_adequacy.advertised_claim: Direct-edge, endpoint-path, and relation-schema novelty are separate claim-specific objects.
semantic_unit_adequacy.must_differ_rule: Different direct triples, endpoint-conditioned paths, or ordered schemas remain distinct within their namespace.
semantic_unit_adequacy.must_match_rule: Realizations with the same frozen claim-specific graph identity must share a semantic ID.
semantic_unit_adequacy.sensitivity_policy: Report endpoint-path and relation-schema overlap separately; neither substitutes for the other.

observation_contract.termination_and_errors: Finite graph enumeration must terminate; missing, malformed, or hash-mismatched source artifacts fail the adapter.

semantic_ids.canonicalization: endpoint path signature fields plus target direct relation
